summary_markdown: The discussion focused on clarifying the definition of the 'Installed Routers' metric within Management KPIs. It was determined that the counter for installed routers increases when a box is created (recorded in `pg.box`), but it does not decrease when the box is removed/decommissioned. Furthermore, this count tracks association with the company level, not the facility level.
decisions: The 'Installed Routers' KPI metric counts boxes upon creation and does not decrement upon removal.
